items.title: Israel strikes southern Lebanon but partial truce with Hezbollah appears to hold
items.description: Israel continues its campaign in the south, though has not struck Beirut after a deal announced by the US.

items.title: 'Whole of Ukraine is in grief' after attacks, but life in Kyiv goes on
items.description: Residents of the capital are shocked to see their neighbourhoods devastated by Russian attacks as they emerge from underground shelters.

items.title: British couple lose Iran jail sentence appeal, family says
items.description: Lindsay and Craig Foreman were arrested in January 2025 during a global motorbike journey.

items.title: Two people shot dead amid Kenya protests against US Ebola quarantine centre plan
items.description: The US plan has sparked public anger and led to demonstrations near the site of the proposed treatment facility.

items.title: Canada formally requests 16-year renewal of North American free trade pact
items.description: In a letter to his North American counterparts, US-Canada Trade Minister Dominic LeBlanc said the three countries should renew the USMCA trade deal.

items.title: Two arrested after four migrant farm workers killed in Italy minivan fire
items.description: CCTV images showed two people blocking the van's doors from the outside and throwing liquid inside to start a fire.

items.title: Maga influencer admits London Tube station assault
items.description: Melissa Rein Lively accepted a caution, while an assault by beating charge against her was withdrawn.

items.title: South Africa police investigate killing of two Mozambican men
items.description: The deaths come after a day of violent protests against illegal migration in the town of Mossel Bay.

items.title: Mysteriously missing New Jersey congressman receives Trump endorsement
items.description: Republican Congressman Tom Kean Jr has not been seen for months but is expected to win Tuesday's election.

items.title: White House Correspondents' Dinner rescheduled after shooting incident
items.description: The annual dinner, which was held in April this year, was interrupted when a gunman stormed a security checkpoint.

items.title: Ghana's anti-LGBTQ+ bill to be scrutinised before approval, president says
items.description: Passed by MPs, the bill proposes prison sentences for people identifying as part of the LGBTQ+ community.

items.title: AI giant Anthropic plans to sell shares in US as valuation nears $1tn
items.description: The AI company behind Claude is set to offer the public the chance to buy and sell shares in the firm later this year.
